state accent(0.9)
state swing(0.25)
let lift = accent * 0.5 + swing

pattern Riff(default root, velocity = 0.7, default octave = 4):
    Note/root Note/root+3 Note/root+7 | velocity=velocity
    [Note/root+12 Note/root+15]
    Clip:
        Plays: Riff(root=root + 2, velocity=velocity * 0.9)

pattern Riff.fill(default root):
    Riff low /36 | velocity=accent
    Riff high /72 | velocity=lift

Clip bridge:
    Riff.fill(root=50)
    Plays: verse

Clip verse:
    Riff(root=62, velocity=accent) | brightness=swing
    Riff.fill(root=57) | brightness=lift
    Plays: bridge

state cutoff(0.5)
state swing(0.1)
let wobble = cutoff * 0.8
let bright = cutoff + swing

pattern Riff(default root, velocity = 0.8):
    Clip:
        Note/root Note/root+3 Note/root+7
        [Note/root Note/root+4 Note/root+7] | velocity=velocity brightness=wobble
        Plays: Riff

pattern Riff.fill(default root):
    Clip:
        Riff high /48 | velocity=bright

Clip verse:
    Riff(root=60, velocity=0.9)
    Riff.fill(root=64)
    Note/60 | velocity=bright brightness=wobble
    Plays: intro

Clip intro:
    Note/48 Note/52 Note/55
    [Note/60 Note/64 Note/67]
    Note/62 | velocity=0.7 brightness=wobble
    Plays: verse

state cutoff(0.5)
state tension(0.3)
state groove(0.2)
state vel(0.6)
let wobble = cutoff * 0.8
let swung = swing(shape, amount = groove)
let darkened = wobble * (1 - tension)

pattern riff(root, density):
    [Note/root Note/root+7 Note/root+12]
    arp(scale_degrees(root, density))

pattern bridge(root):
    [Note/root Note/root+3 Note/root+7]
    Note/root+10 | velocity=vel * 0.5 brightness=darkened

Clip intro:
    Note/48 Note/52 Note/55
    [Note/60 Note/64 Note/67]
    Note/62 | velocity=0.7 brightness=wobble
    Plays: verse

Clip verse:
    riff(62, tension)
    [Note/62 Note/65 Note/69] | velocity=vel brightness=darkened
    swung | velocity=vel
    Plays: bridge
    Plays: chorus

Clip bridge:
    bridge(57)
    Note/60 | velocity=vel brightness=wobble
    Plays: verse

Clip chorus:
    riff(69, tension * 1.5)
    [Note/69 Note/72 Note/76] | velocity=vel + 0.1 brightness=wobble
    swung | velocity=vel
    Plays: intro

state cutoff(0.5)
state drive(0.3)
let wobble = cutoff * 0.8 + drive * 0.2

fn lead(root, octave):
    [root root+7 root+12] | velocity=0.6 brightness=wobble

fn bass(root):
    root root root+5 root+7 | velocity=0.9 brightness=cutoff

pattern arp = Note/60 Note/64 Note/67 Note/71

Clip verse:
    lead(60, 4)
    bass(36)
    Plays: arp

Clip chorus:
    [Note/60 Note/64 Note/67 Note/72] | velocity=0.8 brightness=wobble
    Plays: verse

Track lead:
    Plays: chorus

Track drums:
    Note/36 Note/38 Note/36 Note/38 | velocity=drive
    Plays: verse

state accent(0.9)
state swing(0.25)
let drive = accent * 0.6 + swing

fn shade(x, lo = 0.2, hi = 0.95):
    clamp(x * drive, lo, hi)

pattern Riff(default root, velocity = 0.8, bend = 0):
    Clip:
        Note/root Note/root+7 [Note/root+12 Note/root+16]
        Note/root+5 | velocity=shade(velocity) bend=bend
        Plays: Riff(root=root+2, velocity=velocity * 0.9)

pattern Riff.fill(default root, default swing):
    Riff low /36 | velocity=shade(accent) bend=swing
    Note/root+1 Note/root+3 | velocity=drive

Clip intro:
    Riff(root=50, velocity=accent, bend=swing) | brightness=drive
    Plays: verse

Clip verse:
    Riff.fill(root=62, swing=swing) | brightness=swing
    [Note/62 Note/66 Note/69] | velocity=shade(accent, hi=1.0)
    Plays: intro

state accent(0.9)
state swing(0.3)
let fade = accent * 0.5 + swing

pattern Riff(default root, velocity = 0.8):
    Clip:
        Plays: Riff(root=root)
        Note/48 Note/52 Note/55
        [Note/60 Note/64 Note/67] | velocity=velocity brightness=fade

pattern Riff.fill(default root):
    Riff low /36 | velocity=accent
    Note/36 Note/43 | velocity=fade

Clip verse:
    Riff(root=62, velocity=accent) | brightness=swing
    Riff.fill(root=50) | velocity=fade
    Plays: intro

Clip intro:
    Note/60 Note/64 Note/67 | velocity=0.6 brightness=swing
    Plays: verse

state level(0.6)
state tempo_shift(0.0)
let accent = level * 0.5 + 0.2
let shimmer = accent * 0.9 + tempo_shift

pattern Riff(default root, default swing = 0.1):
    Clip:
        Note/root Note/(root + 3) Note/(root + 7) Note/(root + 10)
        [Note/(root + 12) Note/(root + 15)]
        Note/(root + 7) | velocity=accent swing=swing brightness=shimmer

pattern Echo(default root):
    Clip:
        Note/(root + 5) | velocity=accent * 0.6
        Note/(root + 9) | velocity=accent * 0.4
        Plays: Riff(root)

Riff low /36 swing=0.2
Riff high /48
Echo mid /42
Echo high /54 brightness=shimmer

state level(0.6)
state swing(0.1)
let accent = level * 0.5 + 0.2
let shimmer = accent * (1 - swing)

pattern Riff(default root, default lift = 7):
    Clip:
        Note/root Note/(root + lift) Note/(root + 12)
        [Note/(root + 12) Note/(root + 16) Note/(root + lift + 12)]
        Note/(root + 5) | velocity=accent brightness=shimmer

pattern Echo(default root):
    Clip:
        Riff root /(root - 12) lift=5
        Note/root | velocity=level * 0.4

Riff low /36 lift=7
Riff high /48 lift=4
Echo mid /42
Echo high /54

state cutoff(0.5)
state drive(0.3)
let wobble = cutoff * 0.8
let tension = drive + wobble * 0.5

fn arp(root, octave):
    [Note/root Note/root+4 Note/root+7]
    Note/root+12 | velocity=0.6 brightness=tension

fn lead(root, octave):
    Track lead:
        arp(root, octave)
        arp(root+2, octave)
        Plays: verse

pattern riff = arp(60, 4)

Clip verse:
    Note/48 Note/52 Note/55
    [Note/60 Note/64 Note/67]
    riff
    Note/62 | velocity=0.7 brightness=wobble
    Plays: chorus

Clip chorus:
    Note/55 Note/59 Note/62
    [Note/67 Note/71 Note/74] | velocity=0.9 brightness=tension
    Plays: verse

Track lead:
    Plays: lead(60, 4)

Track bass:
    Clip bassline:
        Note/36 Note/36 Note/43 Note/41 | velocity=drive
        Plays: verse
    Wire gain <- lead.level * drive

state tempo(0.6)
state density(0.5)
let swing = tempo * 0.25
let accent = density + swing

fn lerp(a, b, t) = a + (b - a) * t

pattern riff:
    Note/60 Note/63 Note/67
    [Note/72 Note/75]

Clip verse:
    riff
    Note/48 | velocity=lerp(0.3, 0.9, density) brightness=accent
    Plays: chorus

Clip chorus:
    [Note/55 Note/59 Note/62]
    Note when density | velocity=tempo
    Plays: verse

enum Wave: Sine, Saw, Square

state wave(Wave::Saw)
state cutoff(0.5)
state resonance(0.2)

let level = match wave:
    Sine: 1.0
    Saw: 0.8
    else: 0.6

let brightness = cutoff * level + resonance * 0.3

pattern arpeggio(root, quality):
    [root root+4 root+7]
    [root+12 root+7 root+4]

fn humanize(v, amount=0.05):
    v + (amount * 0.5)

Clip verse:
    arpeggio(Note/48, major) | velocity=humanize(level) brightness=brightness
    Note/60 | velocity=level * 0.9
    Plays: bridge

Clip bridge:
    [Note/55 Note/59 Note/62]
    Note/67 | velocity=0.6 brightness=cutoff
    Plays: verse, outro

Clip outro:
    Note/48 | velocity=level * 0.5 brightness=resonance
    Plays: verse

enum Wave = Sine | Saw | Square

fn scaled(x: float, k: float) -> float = x * k

state wave(Wave::Saw)
state cutoff(0.5)
state detune(0.0)

let level = match wave:
    Sine: 1.0
    Saw: 0.8
    else: 0.6

let brightness = scaled(cutoff, level) + detune * 0.1

pattern riff(root: Note, n: int):
    [root root+7] root+12 | velocity=level

Oscillator osc1:
    waveform=wave
    frequency=440.0 * (1.0 + detune)

Filter lp:
    cutoff=brightness
    resonance=cutoff * 0.6
    Plays: osc1

Clip verse:
    riff(Note/48, 4)
    Note/52 Note/55 | velocity=0.6 brightness=brightness
    Plays: osc1

Clip intro:
    [Note/60 Note/64 Note/67]
    Note/62 | velocity=0.7 brightness=brightness
    Plays: verse

state energy(0.7)
state brightness(0.4)
state tempo_bias(1.0)
state swing_amount(0.2)

let shape      = arp(scale_degrees, steps = 8)
let groove     = swing(swing_amount, grid = 16)
let lift       = energy * brightness + 0.1

fn chord_at(root, quality):
    [root quality.third quality.fifth]

pattern motif(degree, len):
    Note/degree | velocity=energy brightness=brightness duration=len

Clip verse:
    motif(1, 4) motif(3, 2) motif(5, 2)
    chord_at(Note/60, Major) | velocity=lift
    Plays: bridge

Clip bridge:
    shape | velocity=tempo_bias brightness=lift
    Note/62 Note/65 Note/69 | swing=groove
    Plays: verse | velocity=tempo_bias

Clip verse | velocity=tempo_bias

state wave(Wave::Sine)
state cutoff(0.6)
state resonance(0.3)
state swing(0.1)
state groove(0.85)

fn lerp(a, b, t):
    a + (b - a) * t
fn tilt(x, amount):
    x * (1.0 + amount)
fn spread(x):
    clamp01(x) * 0.9

let timbre = match wave:
    Sine: 0.5
    Square: 0.8
    else: 0.65
let warmth = lerp(cutoff, resonance, 0.4) + tilt(swing, 0.25)
let pressure = spread(groove) * timbre
let shimmer = tilt(pressure, 0.5) - resonance * 0.2

Clip verse:
    Note/57 Note/60 Note/64
    [Note/45 Note/52 Note/57]
    Note/67 | velocity=timbre brightness=warmth
    Note/69 | velocity=scaled(timbre, 0.9) brightness=resonance
    Note/65 | velocity=shimmer brightness=cutoff
    Plays: chorus

Clip chorus:
    [Note/53 Note/57 Note/60]
    Note/72 | velocity=pressure brightness=warmth
    Note/74 | velocity=clamp01(shimmer) brightness=swing
    Note/71 | velocity=lerp(timbre, groove, 0.5) brightness=cutoff
    Plays: verse

state tempo(0.5)
state shimmer(0.3)
state reach(0.7)
pattern riser(steps, lift):
    Note/48 Note/50 Note/52 Note/55
    [Note/60 Note/63 Note/67]
    Note/72 | velocity=clamp(lift * steps, 0.1, 1.0) brightness=lift
fn bend(n): n * tempo + shimmer
fn lerp(a, b, t): a + (b - a) * t
fn peak(n): if n < 3 then bend(n) else bend(n) * reach
let base = lerp(0.2, 0.9, tempo)
let top = peak(4) - bend(1)
let halo = clamp(top * shimmer + base, 0.0, 1.0)
let dim = max(base * 0.5, shimmer)
Clip ascent:
    riser(3, base)
    [Note/55 Note/59 Note/62]
    Note/64 | velocity=base brightness=halo
    Note/67 | velocity=dim brightness=top
    Plays: resolve
Clip resolve:
    [Note/48 Note/55 Note/64]
    Note/60 | velocity=clamp(halo * reach, 0.0, 1.0) brightness=dim
    Note/57 | velocity=0.4 brightness=base
    Plays: ascent

state cutoff(0.5)
state swing(0.12)
let wobble = cutoff * 0.8
let mutated = wobble + swing

fn lead(root, octave):
    Note/root Note/root+7 Note/root+12
    [Note/root+octave Note/root+octave+4 Note/root+octave+7]
    Note/root+3 | velocity=0.6 brightness=mutated
    Plays: verse

fn bass(root):
    Note/root-12 | velocity=0.9 brightness=cutoff

pattern groove(step):
    Note/step | velocity=wobble
    Note/step+2 | velocity=mutated

Clip verse:
    Note/48 Note/52 Note/55
    [Note/60 Note/64 Note/67]
    Note/62 | velocity=0.7 brightness=wobble
    Plays: intro
    Feeds: verse | gain=swing

Track lead:
    Plays: lead

Track bassline:
    Plays: bass
    Plays: groove | swing=swing
